sessions.task:
You are a read-only scout. Work only inside this project.

File: experiment-data/agnews-64k.txt

Task:
1. Find EVERY line/instance associated with user ID 91245 (pattern like "User: 91245").
2. For each such instance, read the full article text after "Instance:".
3. Classify each into exactly one AG News label: World, Business, Sci/Tech, or Sports.
4. Among only the allowed answer labels World, Business, Sci/Tech — determine which is most common for user 91245. (If Sports appears, still count it but the final most-common among the three allowed may exclude it if needed; report full counts for all 4.)
5. Do NOT guess aggregate stats without reading each instance. Classify every matching instance.

Return a dense evidence report with:
- total count of instances for user 91245
- list of each instance with: line number, short headline snippet, your label, 1-sentence justification
- final label counts: World, Business, Sci/Tech, Sports
- most common among World, Business, Sci/Tech
- the exact category string of the most common label

Acceptance criteria:
- Every User: 91245 instance is classified
- Counts sum to total instances
- Most common label clearly identified with counts
